developmentFailures.observation: The package test passed and removed its consumer, but the first cleanup observer also counted the tool-created node-compile-cache.
developmentFailures.resolution: The observer now checks the reported consumer directly; its enclosing temporary root and cache are removed separately.

developmentFailures.observation: A profile with existing item IDs 20 and 21 rejected the old default of 1 with uid-floor.
developmentFailures.resolution: Zero in the typed facade now selects the native computed floor; explicit nextUid 22 is asserted.

developmentFailures.observation: Disposable Unity project did not reference the built-in screenshot and image-conversion modules.
developmentFailures.resolution: The verifier includes both built-in modules.

developmentFailures.observation: Numeric courses passed but visual inspection found an entirely black capture.
developmentFailures.resolution: Render mode runs the normal graphical player; a visible-pixel assertion now rejects blank captures.
